title: Normalized Eigenfunctions
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct normalized one-particle energy eigenfunctions for the system.

title: Electron Configuration
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly describe the electron configuration in the ground state according to Pauli's exclusion principle.

title: Excitation Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate the lowest electronic excitation energy correctly.

title: Absorption Wavelength
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct numerical value for the absorption wavelength.

title: Energy Level Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the derivation of the energy levels from the Schrödinger equation.

title: Pauli Exclusion Principle
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the application of the Pauli exclusion principle in determining electron occupancy.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of quantum principles.
